prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1093
Claimant:
Brandon May
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
August 18, 2024
Claim received on a rear-end collision report from the insured's vehicle. The claimant reports neck strain and is not
represented by counsel at this stage.
September 14, 2024
Reviewed the insured's policy and cofnirmed the driver involved is named on the policy. Coverage was in force at the
time of loss, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
September 20, 2024
Spoke with the claimant, who described the impact and the resulitng neck discomfort. The account matched what was
recorded at first notice.
October 17, 2024
Received the photographs from the scene. They confirm the general location and rear-end contact, though some
details are not fully visible in the images.
October 25, 2024
No independent witnesses were identified. The claimant did not provide the other party's details at the scene, and the
claimant joined the claim several days after the collision.
October 31, 2024
Requested prior medical records. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the information gathered so
far.
November 12, 2024
Reviewed the treatment notes. The injury is consistent with the type and force of the collision, and the treatment
followed a typical course.
November 29, 2024
Inspected the vehicle. A few older scratches were noted that may predate this collision, so the scope of damage
attributable to this impact is still being evaluated.
November 30, 2024
Called the claimant again to go over the account. The claimant gave the same description of events as in earlier
conversations.
March 10, 2025
Treatment has tapered as the claimant improved, consistent with the expected recovery pattern. Reserves were
reviewed against the current status.
March 13, 2025
Claim remains open pending the completion of the damage assessment and a final review of the medical records.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
